AI setup & information
The Windows app downloads and runs your offline AI. This website can connect to an AI server already running on your device; browsers may require local-network permission or block it.
In Windows: Settings → LLM → Download AI. If already installed, choose Start AI. No Python or terminal is required.
Conversation uses your selected gem and personality. Owner memory and expressions follow your Companion across LLM changes. PC control and microphone input are not connected yet.

    ON YOUR DEVICE
    Check my voice
    Compare first and repeat playback on your own hardware. Anime voices favour expression; the lighter collection favours a smaller download. Speed depends on your device.
    Reports contain voice settings and timings only. No conversation, memory or audio is included.
    Voice Library
    Audition the installed character and natural-voice collections. Irodori provides original anime voice design; Kokoro and Supertonic are lighter alternative collections. Preview to choose the delivery you prefer. Change collection and language above to browse matching voices.
    No voices match this search.
    Playback & greeting
    Uses the selected Companion and default voice. Requires spoken replies and an installed pack. Greeting audio is cached locally; no LLM is needed. Mouse or keyboard interaction cancels an automatic greeting. Website audio still requires the Windows app.
    Voice override & test line
    Local voices, matched to your Companion and chosen language. Choose a voice and preview it before enabling spoken replies. Your choice is saved separately for each Companion. Language collections reuse installed files.
    Personality affects voice pace and delivery. Kokoro approximates supported reaction cues with brief voiced interjections and pauses; it does not generate realistic laughs, groans or emotional acting. Use [softly], [excited], [sigh], [chuckles] or [groan heavily]. Parentheses also work. Ordinary parentheses stay spoken.
    Download Kokoro VoiceM in the Windows app for matched offline speech.
    Kokoro model: Apache-2.0. Supertonic 3 model: OpenRAIL-M. Runtime and component notices are retained. Original synthetic voices; no subscription.
    Answers with sources
    Online mode sends your question to search, not your owner notes or full history. Windows searches the web; the browser uses Wikipedia. Source links accompany the reply. Explicit “search …” also enables one lookup.
    Opens your browser. Google controls availability and sign-in. AI Mode answers are not automatically imported into Ruby.
